title: Actor type (types/actors/<type>.json)

label.title: Text
label.description: The type name players see; a lang key or literal text.

schema.title: Data schema
schema.description: The entity's data: an object whose properties are fields.

derived.description: Values computed from the data and never stored, by name. Formulas read them as `@derived.<name>`.

controlledBy.description: Who may create actors of the type: players too, or only the GM.

statuses.description: Fields shown on the actor's tokens, in the token list and in the combat tracker while they are on, such as conditions; in order.

field.title: Path
field.description: A true/false field of the type, such as `conditions.prone`, reached through objects only. A secret field’s status shows only to the GM and assistants.

label.title: Text
label.description: What the status is called; a lang key or literal text.

icon.title: Plugin file
icon.description: An image of the plugin, such as `icons/prone.svg`: SVG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF or JPEG. Square, and readable small.

description: An actor type, such as a character or an NPC.

default.description: The value new entities start with; it must fit the field.

enum.description: The allowed values; a `select` input offers them.

enumLabels.description: What a `select` shows for each `enum` value: a lang key or text, by value. The stored value stays the plain value; values without a label show as they are.

minimum.description: The lowest value allowed. On a counter (`x-counter`) it may be a formula, such as `@hp.max`, worked out against the entity on every step.

maximum.description: The highest value allowed. On a counter (`x-counter`) it may be a formula, such as `@hp.max`, worked out against the entity on every step.

format.description: For a `string`: the text must be a dice expression, such as `2d6 + 3` (numbers, dice and + - * / only), or blank. Formulas roll it with `roll(@field)`.

properties.description: The fields of an `object`, by name.

items.description: The rows of an `array`; an `object` for a collection.

x-kind.description: How the core stores and edits the field: `longText` and `richText` are shared text that several people edit at once, `collection` is a list of rows with ids, `image` is a picture URL.

x-counter.description: A number changed in steps; steps from several people at once add up instead of overwriting each other.

x-layer.description: Only the GM and assistants see the field; it never reaches players.
